segments.an10.45:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, rājā mahesiyā saddhiṃ nisinno hoti.
segments.an10.45:1.5: Mahesī vā bhikkhuṃ disvā sitaṃ pātukaroti, bhikkhu vā mahesiṃ disvā sitaṃ pātukaroti.
segments.an10.45:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo aññataraṃ itthiṃ gantvā na sarati –
segments.an10.45:2.4: ‘na kho idha añño koci pavisati, aññatra pabbajitena.
segments.an10.45:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño antepure aññataraṃ ratanaṃ nassati.
segments.an10.45:3.3: ‘na kho idha añño koci pavisati, aññatra pabbajitena.
segments.an10.45:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño antepure abbhantarā guyhamantā bahiddhā sambhedaṃ gacchanti.
segments.an10.45:4.3: ‘na kho idha añño koci pavisati, aññatra pabbajitena.
segments.an10.45:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño antepure pitā vā puttaṃ pattheti putto vā pitaraṃ pattheti.
segments.an10.45:5.3: ‘na kho idha añño koci pavisati, aññatra pabbajitena.
segments.an10.45:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā nīcaṭṭhāniyaṃ ucce ṭhāne ṭhapeti.
segments.an10.45:6.2: Yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.an10.45:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā uccaṭṭhāniyaṃ nīce ṭhāne ṭhapeti.
segments.an10.45:7.2: Yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.an10.45:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā akāle senaṃ uyyojeti.
segments.an10.45:8.2: Yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.an10.45:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā kāle senaṃ uyyojetvā antarāmaggato nivattāpeti.
segments.an10.45:9.2: Yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.an10.45:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño antepuraṃ hatthisammaddaṃ assasammaddaṃ rathasammaddaṃ rajanīyāni rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitassa sāruppāni.
segments.an10.45:10.3: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa ādīnavā rājantepurappavesane”ti.

lines: Pañcame kataṃ vā karissanti vāti methunavītikkamaṃ kariṃsu vā karissanti vā.
Hatthisammaddanti vā pāṭho, tassattho – hatthīhi sammaddo etthāti hatthisammaddaṃ.
Rajanīyāni rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabbānīti etāni rāgajanakāni rūpādīni tattha paripūrāni honti.
Chaṭṭhe khaṇabhaṅguratāya na niccā na dhuvāti aniccā.
Tato eva paṇḍitehi na iccā na upagantabbātipi aniccā.
Svāyaṃ nesaṃ aniccaṭṭho udayavayaparicchinnatāya veditabboti āha “hutvā abhāvino”ti, uppajjitvā vinassakāti attho.
Musāti visaṃvādanaṭṭhena musā, ekaṃsena asubhādisabhāvā te bālānaṃ subhādibhāvena upaṭṭhahanti, subhādiggahaṇassa paccayabhāvena satte visaṃvādenti.
Na passanasabhāvāti khaṇapabhaṅguratāittarapaccupaṭṭhānatāya dissamānā viya hutvā adassanapakatikā.
Ete hi khettaṃ viya vatthu viya hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ca paññāyitvāpi katipāheneva supinake diṭṭhā viya na paññāyanti.
